paper_defaults.autonomous_review: Every nominal quarter routes its first 100 tickets to the CEO; a quarter beginning in DS first returns to SC
paper_defaults.post_q4_abstention_challenge: 50 semantically isolated Extra tickets inherit the Q4 state; the expected model action is abstention
paper_defaults.manual_ds_authorisation: not exercised by the simulated profiles

embedding.similarity: cosine (equivalent to dot product after L2 normalization)

dataset_manifest.embedding_reuse_basis: Record IDs and question text are identical to the base benchmark.
notes: Q1 is the shared canonical baseline and has no possible prior-quarter drift subset.
Q2-Q4 each change forty articles and contain exactly 200 changed-answer near-duplicates (40%).
All 120 quarter/article changes have individually authored rules and change dimensions; every one of the 100 articles changes in at least one post-baseline quarter.
Questions and record IDs exactly match the base 10% benchmark, so its precomputed question embeddings are reused.
The shared post-Q4 Extra split contains 50 mutually isolated questions whose expected model action is abstention.
Drift changes policy or workflow semantics rather than only scalar limits.
Generated files are deterministic outputs of generate_drift_40_dataset.py and salesx_knowledge_drift_40.py.
